description: Active searchable bundle on the store whose children (PDP order) are in the given stock states: untracked (backorder/don't track), tracked (DisablePurchasing, stock >= bundle qty), outOfStock (below it) or available; optional child lead time. KB: Bundled; Inventory.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode); stock is the sum over the store's default and alternate warehouses

child1State.description: State the first child (PDP order) must be in: untracked, tracked, outOfStock or available. Left out = any

child2State.description: State the second child must be in (same values). Left out = any (the child may be missing)

child3State.description: State the third child must be in (same values). Left out = any (the child may be missing)

leadTimeChild.description: Position (1, 2 or 3) of the child that must have a Typical Lead Time (attribute TypicalLeadTime); outputs childNLeadTime. Left out = no lead time needed
